featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience
with this bookshop owner. I purchased a book that was claimed to be the 5th edition, but upon closer inspection, it turned out to be a reprint. When I brought this issue to his attention, he initially refused to exchange it. After some back and forth, he finally agreed to an exchange but insisted that I travel all over Nerul to his chosen location.

As a doctor with a busy schedule, I simply do not have the time to run errands for one book. I even suggested dropping the book off at a nearby store, JJ Store, to make the process easier for both of us, but he outright refused. This lack of flexibility and understanding is unacceptable, especially when the mistake was on his part.

I would not recommend this shop to anyone who values their time or expects decent customer service. A little consideration and professionalism would go a long way!

featured_reviews.name: Kusal Rai
featured_reviews.review_text: Tucked away in an aesthetic corner of South Bombay, this bookstore is a true haven for book lovers. With its charming atmosphere and thoughtfully curated shelves, it offers an impressive range of genres that caters to every kind of reader. Whether you’re hunting for a classic, exploring contemporary fiction, or diving into niche subjects, this place makes browsing feel like an experience rather than just a visit. A must-stop spot for any book nerd wandering through the city.

featured_reviews.name: Anil Bishnoi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ashish Book Centre, tucked away near the bustling CSMT Railway Station in Fort, is nothing short of a paradise for true book lovers. In a city that’s always racing against time, this bookstore feels like a quiet, timeless refuge where stories patiently wait to be discovered.

What makes Ashish Book Centre truly special is its incredible collection. From rare second-hand classics and academic textbooks to novels, competitive exam guides, and out-of-print treasures—you never know what gem you’ll stumble upon. Browsing through the shelves feels like going on a literary treasure hunt, and every visit brings a new surprise.

The owners and staff are extremely knowledgeable and helpful. They don’t just sell books; they understand them. Whether you walk in with a specific title in mind or just a vague idea of what you want to read, they guide you with genuine enthusiasm and honesty. Their passion for books is infectious.

Another big win is the affordability. Ashish Book Centre proves that great reading doesn’t have to be expensive. Students, avid readers, and collectors alike will appreciate the fair pricing and excellent condition of the books.

Located in the heart of Fort, just a stone’s throw from CSMT, it’s incredibly convenient and perfectly placed for a spontaneous visit after work or college. Despite the chaos outside, the store offers a calm, almost nostalgic vibe that reminds you why physical bookstores still matter.

If you love books, value knowledge, or simply enjoy the charm of old-school bookstores, Ashish Book Centre is an absolute must-visit. It’s not just a shop—it’s an experience, a legacy, and a reminder that the love for reading is very much alive in Mumbai. 📚

featured_reviews.name: sk 1
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you Kitab Khana for this beautiful space ! Amidst the city hustle bustle, this is a place to find peace and calm. I wish we had such bookstore in Navi Mumbai as well ! Keep doing what you do and inspire others ! Libraries and book stores are fast losing the race against behemoths like Google & Amazon ! However only the true book lovers understand your worth.

featured_reviews.name: Rakib Sohan
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a wonderful experience at Kitab Khana. The bookstore has a calm and beautiful atmosphere that makes it a perfect place for book lovers. Their collection is impressive, with books ranging from literature and history to art, photography, and modern fiction. The interior is elegant and cozy, creating a peaceful reading environment. The staff were also very friendly and helpful. Definitely one of the best places in Mumbai to relax, explore great books, and spend quality time.

featured_reviews.review_text: Such a beautiful place to see and buy books. In fact, one of the largest that I’ve seen in the same area and the little Coffee Shop inside is fabulous because of the quiet and comfort.

featured_reviews.review_text: Beautiful shop! Has good collection of books on most of the genres. Shop has 2 floors, but most of the books are on the ground floor. The shop has a cafe too! The staff is very helpful! The ambience is awesome! It's a must visit for book lovers! Pay and Park facility is available in the street behind the shop and around Harniman circle.

featured_reviews.name: Mallika Jamy
featured_reviews.review_text:
One if my favourite store whenever I visit Mumbai, just love the children section and especially the illustrations of some of these books. It looks very busy at all times but there is pin drop silence by shoppers, everyone respecting each other's presence in a book store.
Staff are very helpful which makes the buying much more easy.
I have never left without a book and that's the best usp about the place.

featured_reviews.name: Piotr
featured_reviews.review_text:
This bookstore is a gem. The place has real character, beautiful shelves, and that calm “I can spend an hour here without noticing” vibe. The selection is great, especially for business, psychology, self-development and popular non-fiction. You can actually browse properly, not just rush in and out.

Staff were helpful without being pushy, and it’s the kind of bookstore that makes you want to read more. If you like discovering books in a proper space, don’t miss it.

featured_reviews.review_text:
It’s a very chill place with a lot of interesting genres to choose from. The staff here is very helpful and there’s an inhouse Subko cafe so you can sip and read. You can sit for hours(chairs placed in various aisles) and read for free or buy the book. Certain new books have plastic on them so that it stays intact but most of them are not so you flip through pages before buying them.
They also have a 10% -15% discount on all the books all year round so that’s a plus. I loved every bit of it as it screamed classic and elegant and everything book !
